cv: Four contiguous equal-row held-out blocks; fit on remaining training-day rows outside a 10-minute buffer. Training may be on either side; interpolation, not forward forecast.
selection: Highest training-only penalized fitness across three seeded runs; ties prefer fewer inputs then lexicographic chromosome. All-input reference evaluated with identical search estimator/folds.
holdouts: Lock subset before evaluating Phase 2 validation/test. Both were previously seen in Phase 2; comparisons are descriptive, not new independent confirmation.
cost: Input count is a proxy for complexity, not measured power, sensor price or number of sensor nodes.
search_limits: Heuristic finite search, no global optimality guarantee; shared deterministic fitness cache.
